profile.headline: Software Engineer Leader
profile.summary:
I am a curious thinker with a lifelong technology addiction. I have been very blessed to have found a career path in software engineering where I am excited for the new challenges and opportunities that come with every new day.

As a leader in software engineering, I have found that my niche has been in helping teams collaborate and openly communicate what they are working on or even advocating for their work on their behalf. When you hire good people - they generally want to perform well and make good choices, but they need good leaders and navigators to help them guide the ship.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer - Marketing Technology
positions.description: As Principal Software Engineer, I am responsible for Strategy and Engineering Excellence.  I am always thinking about where our systems and processes will be in 1-3 years from now. This includes managing technical debt, software development life cycle, architecture, and planning.  I also challenge my teams to grow by adopting standards and practices that demonstrate their knowledge and plans when building excellent software. My goal is to ensure that we are all working on the same puzzle no matter how complex it is.

projects.title: iDevice implementation

projects.title: MobilePOS
projects.description:
- Analyze existing application for features to add to MobilePOS application
- Added Bluetooth functionality to support operations such as Printing
- Created time clock functionality so users could record time punches regardless if the application was connected to the server or not
- Introduced Automated Build process to expedite QA workflow
